data.body:
Implementation pushed as Gerrit change 2672 (commit da66d5b, rebar-ticket trailer verified).

Held-out TDD note / deviation: implementation was delegated to one subagent that authored both tests and code (not strictly held-out). Compensated with an INDEPENDENT sandboxed mutation-teeth check on the security-critical properties — all had teeth:
- _minimal_env leaking full os.environ -> test_subprocess_contract_strips_environment... RED
- receipt detail leaking the raw expected literal -> test_module_source_equals_matches_by_hash_not_literal RED
- skipping producer-schema validation -> test_schema_diagnostics_and_path_skew_abstain... RED

Validation:
- make lint (ruff + actionlint/zizmor + module-size + complexity + mechanism-delta) PASS; make typecheck PASS.
- grounding + workflow suites: 1203 passed, 1 skipped (pinned_upstream_canary correctly skipped without the binary).
- Full suite: fixed the 3 c6ce-caused failures (two mechanism-delta baseline==live/new=0 tests + the predates-gate parity test) by baselining the two new ci_gate lane steps in .github/mechanism-baseline.json (marker + baseline entry, matching the prompt-eval/fixture_heal precedent) and adding a '# predates-gate-ok:' marker inside the canary run body. The 2 remaining full-suite failures are pre-existing/environmental and NOT c6ce-caused: test_rebar_repo_isolation::test_copy_repoints_sibling_origin_and_keeps_refs_isolated FAILS on clean HEAD 10af5f28 (verified via stash), and test_reconcile_live_e2e::test_delete_permission_probe is a live-Jira e2e. Both owned by the parallel main-green session.
- corroborator hardening reviewed: basename-only PATH resolve + repo-containment rejection, SHA-256 before/after, read-only symlink-free snapshot, shell=False --json <snapshot>, minimal stripped env, process-group reap under 60s, path-escape validation, digest-only receipts.
- ADR 0115 amended with section 6 carving terraform-config-inspect as the one audited exception to the section-1 'no external process' rule.

Next: drive 2672 to LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, then Submit and close.
